author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-18 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: The dreamer in you is God.
context_before: Son and God the Holy Spirit, can be taken in a simple way as Mighty Father, the proceeding Son, and the returning Holy Spirit – for they are all one.
context_after: Tonight as you dream ask yourself where you are. Many times while lying on my bed I have left this body I know so well, to enter a world just as real as this. Remembering where my body was when I started my journey, when I desired to return I had to feel myself in the body – now cataleptic – on the bed. I could not move it or open its eyes. The body felt dead, yet I was very much alive. Gradually I was able to move a finger, then the toes. But only as I opened my eyes and saw the familiar objects on the wall and dresser did I know I was back. But was I really? Am I not dreaming this world just as much as I was dreaming that one? If so then where am I right now?
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from God Speaks To Man (1968-01-18).

quote_original: A dream contains one central thought.
context_before: as a vision then this one is also, for one world does not differ from the other. So God has two ways of speaking to man, but man does not perceive it.
context_after: Like a thank you note. You don’t try to interpret every word in it, just the message it is trying to convey.

author: Neville Goddard
rights_note: Delivered in public spoken lecture on 1968-01-18 in the United States; public domain under 1909 US Copyright Act.
quote_original: This gentleman had a wonderful experience.
context_before: The central figure of Christianity is the Human Imagination. When you accept this as the first principle of religion, then all governments, rituals, and external worship will have heard the trumpets of Joshua. All of the buildings that are of any structure than that Rock – which is your own wonderful Human Imagination – will fall.
context_after: He is on the Rock, but he may move from it. He may turn his back and forget that the cause of all of the phenomena of his life is the Human Imagination. It is my hope that he will not.
selection_note: Verbatim lecture excerpt from God Speaks To Man (1968-01-18).

author: Neville Goddard

quote_original: I’m not saying this is true.
context_before: nd millions of years; yet one generation could be more instantaneous than the nth part of a second, if you are going to measure life in terms of time.
context_after: I am only giving you something to think about. If you do, you will change your mind about having an ape for an ancestor.
